checkpoint_review: I agree with the Router's assessment on all checkpoints. The image fails to meet the core definition of a street sign due to illegible text and non-standard structure. Specifically, 'Text, symbols, or pictograms' and 'Standardized typography' are correctly marked as missing because the characters are nonsensical glyphs. The structural checkpoints regarding the post and mounting are also correctly identified as missing or untestable due to the ambiguous, fused connection on the right side. The color scheme checkpoint is correctly failed as it uses dark brown/black instead of standard regulatory colors.
artifact_review: The Router correctly identified 'text_gibberish' as a severity 5 artifact; this is the primary failure mode. I agree with the 'structural_collapse' (severity 3) observation at the right-side connection point where the sign fuses with the support pole. I also agree with 'perspective_distortion' (severity 2) on the lower panel lettering. No new artifacts were found by experts, but the Router's identification of the fusion error is critical and sufficient to justify a low artifact score alongside the text failure.
alignment_reasoning: Only 1 out of 9 testable checkpoints passed (High-contrast coloration). The object lacks functional text, standardized typography, correct material appearance, and proper mounting geometry. It resembles a stylized prop rather than a functional street sign. The initial alignment score of 0.85 was inconsistent with the reasoning that only 1/7 testable checkpoints passed; the formula reference of 0.63 accurately reflects this severe misalignment.
artifact_reasoning: Catastrophic text rendering failure (gibberish) combined with structural fusion at the mounting point and perspective warping of lettering. These defects render the object non-functional and visually incoherent as a real-world sign.
key_defects: Structural fusion between sign and support pole
self_reflection_notes: Corrected alignment_score from 0.85 to 0.63. The initial score contradicted the checkpoint review which confirmed only 1/7 testable checkpoints passed. Per Checklist Item #1 (Score-Reasoning Consistency), the score must align with the evidence; 0.63 matches the formula reference and the severity of failures. Artifact_score remains 1.2 as the Router's identification of severity 5 text gibberish and severity 3 structural collapse justifies this low score without over-penalizing (Checklist Item #5). All expert testimonies were considered, confirming no additional defects beyond those noted by the Router.
